title: Aakhri Chitthi
spoiler_safe_logline: Six years after leaving home without a word, Meera returns to her village - and to a brother who has not forgiven her - just as the last letter their father left behind goes missing.
synopsis: Meera returns to the Sharma haveli after six years in Delhi. Her mother Kamla is overjoyed; her younger brother Arjun, who left college to run the household, is openly hostile. Kamla reveals that Meera's late father Shankar left a letter to be opened only when Meera came home, but the letter has vanished from Kamla's tin box. Their uncle Raghav has it. Arjun, prompted by the postman Bansi Kaka, starts tracing the monthly money orders from Delhi that Raghav passes off as shop profit. After a confrontation in which Arjun shoves Raghav and a lantern shatters, Raghav hands over the letter. Read aloud, it reveals that Raghav forged Shankar's signature on a loan against the house, and that Meera left to repay it in secret at her dying father's request. Arjun and Meera reconcile; Raghav leaves to confess to the bank and the panchayat. The episode ends as Bansi delivers a registered letter from Delhi in handwriting Meera recognises.
